Head & Neck 1 Comprehensive Quiz

A self-paced review for Head & Neck 1, built from the course lectures, the cranial nerve chart and the compiled course notes. Topics follow the course: the twelve cranial nerves and their skull exits, brainstem nuclei and functional columns, the autonomic supply of the head and neck, axial muscles, the special senses, each nerve in detail, the cervical plexus, and cranial nerve lesions and reflexes. Twelve drag-and-match questions cover the eye, the inferior surface of the brain, the skull base foramina, the muscles of facial expression, three regions of the interactive cranial nerve map, and Dr. Novak's cranial nerve chart one column at a time. Your progress (answers and flags) is automatically saved in this browser. Use the ✕ beside a choice to eliminate it, then select an answer for immediate feedback with the correct answer and explanation. Filter to Incorrect or Flagged and hit Reset & retry to work through just those.
